unit.why: A short narrative: the Maggid of Kozienice arranges his daughter's match and, at the wedding ceremony, waits a long time with strange movements to draw down the soul of the Shakh, whose consent was needed.

stories.start_quote: עו"ש בשם הרב מסעראצק המגיד מקאזניץ
stories.end_quote: המשיך את נשמת הש"ך ז"ל לשם
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Kozienice seeks Avi Ezra Zelig, of the lineage of the Bach and the Shakh, as his son-in-law; at the start of the betrothal ceremony he waits a long time with strange movements, later explaining that the Shakh had not consented to the match, which would not have lasted, so he drew the Shakh's soul down to the wedding.
